EVIDENCE.json / DOSSIER.json for EO 9447 (FR catalog and 1989 codification: superseded by EO 9744B)
reasoning: Genuine version differs from the plant only in the six end dates (A1b/A2b/A3b 1945-06-30; B1/B6 and whole order 1946-07-01); those dates now match the sources: the rows say 'For the fiscal year 1945', and EO 9744B (June 29, 1946, 11 FR 7391) supersedes EO 9447 and 'shall be in effect for the fiscal year 1947'. Identity (EO 9447, June 8, 1944, 9 FR 6293, effective July 1, 1944), hashes, spans and the five-subsection inventory all check out. Held later amendments of EO 9356 (9465, 9525, 9583, 9642) do not touch B1 or B6; EO 9583 (July 2, 1945) replaced the A rows for fiscal year 1946, which is consistent with the fiscal-year-1945 own-terms end. It is still rejected on the two defects the blind review found that the plant did not cause: the cited ending quote for the A rows is the whole text file, and the order's amending command is not ended on issue as ruling P2 requires. This is the same standard applied to EO 11294 and EO 11943/12701 in this set.
